mobile-cocktail-bar.name: Cocktail Bar
mobile-cocktail-bar.h1: Mobile Cocktail Bar Catering in Barcelona for Weddings, Corporate Events & Private Parties
mobile-cocktail-bar.shortDescription: Our signature service: a fully staffed mobile cocktail bar for weddings, corporate events, and private parties across Barcelona and beyond. We bring the counter, the bartenders, the glassware, and a cocktail menu built around your event. All you bring is the guest list. The bar scales easily, whether you're hosting 40 people on a rooftop or 300 in a conference hall.
mobile-cocktail-bar.metaTitle: Mobile Cocktail Bar for Weddings & Corporate Events
mobile-cocktail-bar.metaDescription: Book a mobile cocktail bar in Barcelona for weddings, corporate events & private parties. Custom menus, real bartenders. Get your quote today.
mobile-cocktail-bar.heroImageAlt: [COPY PENDING — Cocktail Bar — EN — Hero Image Alt]

paragraphs: Chin Chin Bar Catering runs a fully staffed mobile cocktail bar for weddings, corporate events, and private parties across Barcelona and beyond. We bring the counter, the bartenders, the glassware, and a cocktail menu built around your event. All you bring is the guest list. The bar scales to fit the room, whether that's 40 people on a rooftop or 300 in a conference hall.

included.title: What's Included
included.lead: Every booking is a complete cocktail bar for events of any size:
items: A portable bar counter, styled to suit your venue and color scheme
Professional bartenders, usually two to six, depending on guest count and bar hours
Full equipment: shakers, jiggers, strainers, ice wells, garnish stations
Real glassware as standard (plastic only if the venue requires it)
Ice, mixers, and fresh garnishes, sourced and prepped in advance
Setup before your event and full breakdown after, so you won't need to clean anything up

items.name: Weddings
items.text: Cocktail hour, reception, or both: we build the bar around your day's timing. Many couples choose two or three signature cocktails, sometimes named after them or tied to how they met. We coordinate directly with planners and venues so service lines up with the rest of the schedule.

items.name: Corporate Events
items.text: Corporate events need service that looks sharp and runs on schedule, whether it's a product launch, a conference, a holiday party, or a client dinner. We can brand cocktails around your company colors or campaign, keep things understated for a formal dinner, or make the bar the centerpiece of a launch.

items.name: Private Parties
items.text: This is where the cocktail menu gets more playful. Birthdays, anniversaries, and milestone celebrations are the kind of night where guests want to request drinks on the spot, so we scale the setup down for smaller, more casual gatherings under 50 people.

menu.title: Menu & Non-Alcoholic Options
paragraphs: Every custom cocktail menu starts with a conversation: your favorite spirits, flavors to avoid, and what's in season. From there we build a list of signature cocktails (usually four to six) plus a full menu of non-alcoholic cocktails made with the same technique and quality ingredients as the alcoholic ones. Open bar, a limited selection, or drink tickets: the format is yours to choose.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
steps: Tell us your date, location, and guest count.
We send a custom quote and a draft cocktail menu.
We confirm the final menu, staffing, and bar setup together.
On the day, we arrive early, set up, serve, and clean up. You don't lift a glass.

international.title: Events Outside Barcelona
paragraphs: Barcelona is home base, but it's not the limit. We take on international events and destination events when the logistics work. Get in touch with your location and date, and we'll walk you through what's involved in bringing the bar to you.

cta.title: Ready to Book Your Cocktail Bar?
cta.text: Tell us about your event and we'll build a menu, a quote, and a plan around it. Request a consultation today and let's start planning.

items.question: What does a mobile cocktail bar from Chin Chin cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on guest count, bar hours, and menu selection. There's no flat rate because every event is different. Share your event details and we'll send a tailored quote. [COPY PENDING — Cocktail Bar — EN — FAQ price range]

items.question: How long does the bar run for?
items.answer: Most bookings run 3 to 5 hours, though we can extend service or split it into cocktail hour plus reception on request.

items.question: Do you offer non-alcoholic options, and is there a minimum guest count?
items.answer: Yes. Every menu includes mocktails alongside the alcoholic cocktails. [COPY PENDING — Cocktail Bar — EN — FAQ minimum guest count]

items.question: Can you cater events outside Barcelona, including abroad?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly take on international events and destination weddings. Reach out with your location and date and we'll walk you through logistics and cost.

intro.title: A real bar — it just skips the alcohol
paragraphs: A healthy bar isn't a table with juice cartons. It's the same bar station, the same technique and the same service as a cocktail event: fresh citrus, house syrups, proper ice, chilled glassware.
The only difference is what sits at the base — protein, fruit, vegetables and infusions instead of spirits. Guests get a drink with real structure and balance, not sugar water over ice.

offerings.title: Three bases the menu is built from

items.name: Protein shakes
items.text: Dairy or plant base, whey isolate or plant protein, banana, peanut butter, cacao, dates. 18–22 g of protein per serving, no added sugar.

items.name: Smoothies
items.text: Thick fruit and vegetable bases over ice: mango-passion fruit, spinach-apple-celery, berry-beetroot. Blended to order — no concentrates, no powders.

items.name: Mocktails
items.text: Cocktail technique without the proof: house syrups, shrubs, cold infusions, fresh juice. Same glassware, same garnish, same presentation.

items.text: We build the list around your format and budget, and confirm allergens and plant-based swaps.

items.name: Event day
items.text: We arrive two hours before the start, set up the station and work the full slot.

items.name: After
items.text: Clearing the bar area is on us. The equipment leaves with us the same day.

items.question: Can the healthy bar run alongside a regular cocktail bar?
items.answer: Yes — that's the most common setup. Either two stations side by side or one station with two lists. Guests choose for themselves and nobody feels left out.

items.question: What about allergens and diets?
items.answer: Every drink can be built on plant milk, and whey can be swapped for plant protein. Nut butters stay in clearly labelled drinks. A full ingredient and allergen list goes out with the menu before the event.

items.question: How many guests can one station handle?
items.answer: Roughly up to 120 servings per hour with one bartender, assuming the bases are batched in advance. Above 150 guests with a short service window we add a second bartender.

items.question: Do you need power on site?
items.answer: Yes — the blenders need a 220 V socket next to the station. If the venue has none, tell us in advance: we either bring a generator or move part of the menu to blender-free drinks.

items.question: How far do you travel?
items.answer: Barcelona and the surrounding area at no extra cost. Elsewhere in Catalonia we quote per event, depending on logistics.

cta.title: Tell us about your event
cta.text: Date, location and a rough guest count are enough for us to come back with a menu and a quote within a day.
